title: Meta system user access token in a generation or refresh response member
summary: A synthetic system user access token as the access_token member of a generation response, of a refresh response and of a raw HTTP refresh response.
rationale: Meta documents that a system user access token is returned by the generation request and, when refreshed, as the access_token member of the oauth/access_token response. The documentation states no prefix, alphabet or width and says token length changes over time, so the member name is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The system user id and business id are public identifiers, and the user, Page and Instagram tokens are separate families with their own carriers.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of the access_token member of a system user token generation or refresh response is treated as a credential. Meta documents the generation and refresh responses (carrier existence only); the value admission and extent are the project's decisions.

sources.supports: The response returns the access token string.
